expected.name: Calixto Guerra
expected.description: Calixto Guerra was named in contemporary rosters of Mexican revolutionaries associated with the Partido Liberal Mexicano who were jailed or prosecuted under U.S. neutrality laws. The record states nearly all spent months in jail before being freed but does not establish precise individual dates.

updates.sentence:
Named in contemporary rosters of Mexican revolutionaries jailed or prosecuted under U.S. neutrality laws; the record states nearly all spent months in jail but does not establish precise individual dates.

Charges as recorded: Jailed, held for extradition, or prosecuted under U.S. neutrality laws as a Partido Liberal Mexicano member

John Murray personally visited Guerra in Maverick County Jail, Eagle Pass, Texas, and described the pending extradition proceedings before Judge W. C. Douglas in the July 1909 International Socialist Review, pp.88 and90. The hearing had not yet been scheduled when he wrote. The visit establishes custody, not the date it began. Source: https://www.marxists.org/history/usa/pubs/isr/v10n01-jul-1909-ISR-gog.pdf#page=88
